title: fix: #30199 add no-cache check when cache-ttl=0
body:

commits. (`git commit -s`). (If needed, use `git commit -s --amend`).  The author email must match
the sign-off email address. Read the [DCO Sign-off requirements](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#DCO-Sign-off)
and ensure you follow them before signing off your commits.
- [x] Referenced issues using `Fixes: #00000` in commit message (if applicable)

- [x] [Release note](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/guide/release-notes.md) entered in the section below (or `None` if no user-facing changes)

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

<!--
Write `None` if there are no user-facing changes, otherwise enter your release note below.
Include "action required" if users need to take action when upgrading.
-->

```release-note
Update `podman build` logic when setting cache TTL to 0 with `--cache-ttl=0` to automatically set the `--no-cache` option to `true` and throw an error when attempting to set `--no-cache=false`
```

comments.body: Code change is adapted from the equivalent flag logic in `buildah` [here](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/blob/main/pkg/cli/build.go). Docs already referenced the proper functionality of the flag.

@tommatime Thanks for the PR.
One more lint issue:

```
Error: cmd/podman/common/build.go:563:2: unnecessary trailing newline (whitespace)
```
Rebased, squashed, and added `Fixes: #30199` to message
